translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: kendo chiege odhi moweye mi okende gi dichwo machielo,
To isedak kaka ochot man-gi johera mangʼeny
kuonde motimo ongoro motingʼore mondo ine.
E dir yo ne ibet piny ka irito johera magi,
ibet piny ka jakwath mamanyo pi ne dhoge e piny motwo.
kendo kodh chwiri pod ok ochwe.
wiyi bende ok kuodi nikech ionge gi wichkuot.
Bende mirimbi biro bedo manyaka chiengʼ?
to itimo timbe mamono duto minyalo.”

content: E kinde mar loch Ruoth Josia, Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Bende iseneno gima Israel ma ok ja-ratiro otimo? Osedhi ewi gode duto matindo maboyo kendo e bwo yiende duto motimo otiep mi osechodo kanyo.
Ne aparo ni kane osetimo magi duto to ne odhi duogo ira makmana ne ok odwogo, kendo kata mana nyamin mare ma Juda ma ok ja-ratiro noneno mano.
Ne amiyo Israel maonge gi yie baruwa mar weruok kendo mi ariembe nikech timbene duto mag chode. Kata kamano ne aneno ka nyamin-gi ma Juda maonge ratiro ne ok oluor; en bende nodhi kendo ochodo.
Nikech anjawo mar Israel nonenore gima tin, ne gidwanyo piny ka gilamo kite kod bepe.
To kuom magi duto, nyamin mare ma Juda ma ok ja-adiera ka en ne ok odwogo ira gi chunye duto, to mana kuom wuondruok,” Jehova Nyasaye ema owacho.
Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Israel maonge gi yie ler moloyo Juda ma ok ja-adiera.
Dhi mondo iland wachni yo nyandwat ni:

content.text: ok anabed gi mirima kodi kendo,
iya ok bi wangʼ kodi nyaka chiengʼ.
isekayo timbegi mag ngʼwono mana ne nyiseche manono

content: Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Dwoguru ira, un joga maonge yie, nimar an e chworu. Abiro yierou ka ngʼato achiel oa e dala to ji ariyo koa e anywola mi akelu Sayun.
Eka anamiu jokwath ma chunygi chal koda, mabiro telonu gi rieko kod winjo.”

Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “E ndalogo, kakwanu osemedore mangʼeny e piny, ji ok nochak owuo kawacho ni, ‘Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.’ Ok enodonji e parogi bende ok ginipare; ok nodware, kata moro ok nolosi kendo.

E kindeno gibiro luongo Jerusalem ni Kom Loch mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo ogendini duto nochokre ei Jerusalem mondo omi nying Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ. Ok ginichak gitim tim wich teko, bende ok ginibed gi chuny mar timo richo.
E ndalogo od Juda biro riwore gi od Israel, kendo giduto ginibi ka gia e piny ma yo nyandwat nyaka e piny mane amiyo kwereu kaka girkeni.

content.text: “ ‘Mano kaka dabed mamor ka akawou kaka yawuota
girkeni maber mogik mar piny moro amora.’
Ne aparo ni unyalo luonga ni ‘Wuonwa,’
To mana ka dhako ma ok ja-ratiro ne chwore,
omiyo usebedo maonge gadieri kuoma, yaye od Israel,”
Ywak iwinjo e kuonde motingʼore motimo ongoro,
en kuyo gi secho mar jo-Israel,
kendo wigi osewil gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
abiro thiedhou kuom baro weyo yo.”
nimar in Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.
Adiera lamo nyiseche mopa ewi gode matindo,
adier kuom Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa,
Chakre tinwa nyiseche manono mag wichkuot
kod kweth mag dhok, yawuotgi kod nyigi.
We wanind piny e wichkuot marwa,
Wasetimo richo ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa,
chakre ndalo mane wan rowere nyaka odiechiengni
pod ok waluoro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.”
